theater: 波蘭走廊與中部戰線至華沙

battle.name: 波蘭戰役
battle.theater: 波蘭走廊與中部戰線至華沙
battle.brief: 一九三九年九月一日德軍自北、西、南三面越境，十七日蘇軍自東面進入，波蘭軍隊在三十六天內被逐出國土。卡面的四號坦克是德軍一九三七年量產的中坦，在戰役中擔任攻堅與步兵支援的重裝武器，編配各裝甲師，參與莫克拉與布祖拉河一線的突擊。

kit.name: 四號坦克
kit.history: 四號坦克是德軍在二戰初期的主力中坦，負責支援步兵與對抗敵方裝甲，並參與閃擊戰術的實施。

countries: 波蘭戰役自一九三九年九月一日德軍越境起，至十月初全境被德軍與蘇軍控制止，交戰方分為三條戰線：德軍與斯洛伐克聯軍自北、西、南三面進攻，波蘭軍獨力應戰，蘇聯紅軍自十七日起自東面進入。德方最高決策在元首希特勒，最高統帥部由威廉·凱特爾主持，陸軍總司令為瓦爾特·布勞姆希克，具體作戰計畫由陸軍參謀總長弗蘭茨·哈爾德擬定，計畫代號「白色方案」，要求在英法完成動員之前速戰速決。德軍分為兩個兵團群：南方兵團群由龍德施泰特率領，下轄第四軍、第八軍與第十三軍；北方兵團群由費多爾·馮·博克率領，下轄第七軍與第一軍。萊歇瑙率第七軍自波美拉尼亞沿波羅的海岸向東推進，布拉斯科維茨率第八軍自波茲南走廊南下，庫赫勒率第十三軍自斯洛伐克越過喀爾巴阡山，李斯特率第十四軍自南部邊境壓進。裝甲與摩托化部隊另成體系：古德里安指揮第十九摩托化軍團，轄第二裝甲師與第二騎兵師；隆美爾以第三輕裝師在莫克拉一線撕開邊界。波蘭方面由元帥里茲-希米格爾任最高統帥，總參謀部作戰處長斯塔赫維奇主持策劃，軍區劃分為北部軍團、莫拉維亞軍團、波茲南軍團、中部軍團及南方軍團，另有海軍與空軍獨立作戰。
countriesEn: The Polish Campaign ran from the German crossing of the border on 1 September 1939 until German and Soviet forces controlled the entire country in early October, and it was fought along three separate fronts: German and Slovak forces attacking from the north, the west and the south, the Polish Army fighting alone, and the Soviet Red Army entering from the east on 17 September. On the German side the final decision rested with the Führer, Adolf Hitler; the High Command was headed by Wilhelm Keitel, the commander-in-chief of the army was Walter von Brauchitsch, and the operational plan itself was drawn up by the army chief of staff, General Franz Halder under the code name Fall Weiss, with the aim of finishing the war before Britain and France could complete their mobilisation. The German army was split into two army groups: Army Group South under Gerd von Rundstedt contained the 4th, 8th and 13th Armies, while Army Group North under Fedor von Bock contained the 7th and 1st Armies. Reichenau led the 7th Army eastwards along the Baltic shore out of Pomerania, Blaskowitz led the 8th Army south out of the Poznan corridor, Küchler led the 13th Army across the Carpathians from Slovakia, and List led the 14th Army in from the southern border. Armour and motorised troops formed a separate system: Heinz Guderian commanded the XIX Motor Corps, which carried the 2nd Panzer Division and the 2nd Cavalry Division, and Rommel used the 3rd Light Division to tear open the front at Mokra. On the Polish side Marshal Edward Rydz-Smigly was supreme commander, the chief of the operational staff General Waclaw Stachiewicz ran the planning, and the army was divided into the Northern, Mazovian, Poznan, Central and Southern army groups, with the navy and the air force operating independently.
people: 德軍一方的關鍵人物是希特勒，他以「白色方案」授權並在九月二十八日到但澤演說；陸軍參謀總長哈爾德力排眾議，限制裝甲兵深入作戰，使德軍在波蘭仍以步兵攻勢為主；龍德施泰特與馮·博克分掌南北兩個兵團群；萊歇瑙、庫赫勒、李斯特各率一軍完成側翼合圍；古德里安以第十九摩托化軍團在維茲納一線快速推進，隆美爾以第三輕裝師在莫克拉撕開缺口。面對古德里安第十九軍團的波美拉尼亞烏赫蘭騎兵團團長卡齊米日·馬斯塔萊爾茨，在九月一日的圖霍拉森林一役迫使德軍第二十步兵師退卻散開，團隊折損近三分之一，此役後來在國外被誇大成波蘭騎兵用長矛衝鋒坦克的傳說。波蘭方面的核心是最高統帥元帥愛德華·里茲-希米格爾，他於九月十日下令全軍退向羅馬尼亞橋頭堡；西部「沃迪斯瓦夫」集團軍指揮官約瑟夫·奧爾希納-維爾欽斯基中將與第一軍軍長弗瓦迪斯瓦夫·莫茲同在九月十二日陣亡；波茲南軍指揮官米切斯瓦夫·斯莫拉維斯基、第五步兵師師長瓦迪斯瓦夫·安德斯、第十四軍軍長斯坦尼斯瓦夫·達貝克在後續戰鬥中相繼投入；第十摩托化騎兵師師長尤利烏什·波尼亞托夫斯基在九月十九日的莫克拉戰鬥中陣亡。總統伊格納齊·莫希奇茨基與總理斯武沃伊·斯克拉多夫斯基在開戰首日離開華沙。蘇聯方面，最高領袖斯大林在諾門罕停火後才批准出兵，國防人民委員伏羅希洛夫與紅軍總參謀長沙波什尼科夫分掌軍政。
peopleEn: On the German side the key figure was Hitler, who authorised Fall Weiss and who spoke in Danzig on 28 September. The army chief of staff Halder argued against the majority and limited how deep armour could operate on its own, so the campaign was still fought around the infantry. Rundstedt and von Bock commanded the two army groups; Reichenau, Küchler and List each led a formation that closed the ring around the Polish armies; Guderian drove the XIX Motor Corps rapidly along the Wizna and Brzesc line, and Rommel opened the line at Mokra with the 3rd Light Division. Against Guderian's XIX Army Corps the commander of the 18th Pomeranian Uhlan Regiment, Kazimierz Mastalerz, forced the German 20th Infantry Division to withdraw in the Tuchola forest on 1 September, at the cost of nearly a third of his men, and this engagement was later distorted abroad into the legend of Polish lancers charging tanks. On the Polish side the central figure was the supreme commander, Marshal Edward Rydz-Smigly, who on 10 September ordered the entire army back towards the Romanian bridgehead. The commander of the western Wodzislaw group, General Josef Olszyna-Wilczynski, and the commander of the 1st Army, Wladyslaw Motz, were both killed on 12 September; the commander of the Poznan Army, Mieczyslaw Smorawinski, the commander of the 5th Infantry Division, Wladyslaw Anders, and the commander of the 14th Army, Stanislaw Dabek, were thrown into the fighting in turn; the commander of the 10th Motorised Cavalry Division, Juliusz Poniatowski, was killed at Mokra on 19 September. President Ignacy Moscicki and Prime Minister Felicjan Slawoj Skladkowski left Warsaw on the first day of the war. On the Soviet side Stalin released the Red Army only after the ceasefire in the Far East, with the People's Commissar for Defence Voroshilov and the chief of the general staff Shaposhnikov in charge of the armed forces.
kits: 卡面這件四號坦克是德軍一九三七年量產的中型坦克，A型裝五厘米口徑的 KwK 39 L/60 炮，備彈約八十發，三十毫米首上裝甲，梅巴赫 HL120 汽油機約二百六十五馬力，乘員四人，戰時全重約二十五噸，最高時速約四十公里。波蘭戰役中它是各裝甲師的骨幹重裝武器，配屬於第一、第二、第三、第四、第十裝甲師等單位，編組上多集中於裝甲旅與突擊群。其使用方式偏重兩端：一是對堅固陣地與鄉村房屋據點抵近射擊，二是掩護步兵推進並支援裝甲偵察。在莫克拉與布祖拉河一線，四號坦克與三號、三十八式追擊砲並肩作戰，前者以火炮壓制波軍七TP輕坦與鄉間防線，後者則以低伸射角打擊樹林與塹壕。戰前它還曾在薩爾前線的貝利蒙堡攻堅中抵近射擊，並有一輛以四號坦克底盤試裝八厘米突擊砲的原型車「斯圖勒·埃米爾」在布祖拉河一線出現。波蘭方面的裝甲則以自研七TP輕坦為主，戰前五年全國僅生產約一百四十輛，另有少量雷諾 R35、Vickers E 四輪裝甲車與 TKS 坦克車，編為兩個裝甲旅、四個獨立坦克營及數十個分連；波軍另有三七與四五厘米反坦克砲，七TP配屬波佛斯三七毫米炮，而步兵師對付裝甲目標仍以三七厘米砲為主。運輸方面，德軍靠半履帶裝甲汽車、三輪摩托車與摩托化步兵團維持縱深補給，波軍則以十萬匹軍馬、徵用民用車隊與鐵路輸送維持撤退，指揮所依賴的電話線與道路屢遭空軍打擊。空軍方面，德軍以 Ju 87 俯衝轟炸機、He 111 與 Do 17 轟炸機協同地面作戰，波蘭空軍有 PZL P.11、P.7、P.23 與 P.37 轟炸機，但新購的法製 M.S.406 與英製戰鬥機運抵太遲，沒有投入戰鬥。德國海軍以老式戰列艦「石勒蘇益格-荷爾斯泰因」號炮擊維斯特普拉特，波蘭潛艇「鷹號」在格但斯克灣自沉，驅逐艦隊則於八月底提前北撤至英國。
kitsEn: The vehicle on the card, the Panzerkampfwagen IV, was mass-produced from 1937; the Ausf. A carried a 5 cm KwK 39 L/60 gun with roughly eighty rounds, 30 mm frontal armour, the Maybach HL120 petrol engine of about 265 horsepower, a crew of four, a combat weight of about 25 tonnes and a top speed near 40 km/h. In the Polish campaign it was the heavy backbone of the panzer divisions, assigned to units such as the 1st, 2nd, 3rd, 4th and 10th Panzer Division, and concentrated in the panzer regiments and battle groups. Its employment ran to two extremes: firing at close range against fortified positions and village strongpoints, and shielding the infantry and the armoured reconnaissance. At Mokra and along the Bzura the Panzer IV worked shoulder to shoulder with the Panzer III and the 38(t) assault guns, the former pressing Polish 7TP light tanks and fieldworks with its gun, the latter firing at tree lines and trench lines from a low angle. Before the war it had also been used at point-blank range against Fort Brialmont on the Saar front, and one prototype carrying an 8 cm assault howitzer on the Panzer IV chassis, the Sturer Emil, is recorded as having appeared on the Bzura. The Polish armoured force was built around the locally designed 7TP light tank, of which only about one hundred and forty were produced in the five years before the war, together with a handful of Renault R35 and Vickers E armoured cars and TKS tankettes, organised as two armoured brigades, four independent tank battalions and some thirty TKS companies; the Polish army also had 3.7 cm and 4.5 cm anti-tank guns, with the 7TP carrying a Bofors 37 mm gun. Against armoured targets the infantry divisions still relied on 3.7 cm guns. On the logistics side the Germans used half-track armoured personnel carriers, three-wheeled motorcycles and motorised infantry to keep the advance supplied, while the Polish army depended on some one hundred thousand army horses, requisitioned civilian convoys and the railways; the telephone lines and roads on which command depended were repeatedly cut by air attack. In the air the Germans flew Ju 87 dive bombers, He 111 and Do 17 bombers in support of the ground; the Polish air force had the PZL P.11, P.7, P.23 and P.37, but newly bought French M.S.406 fighters and British types arrived too late to fight. At sea the German battlecruiser Schleswig-Holstein shelled Westerplatte, the Polish submarine Orzel scuttled herself in the Gulf of Danzig, and the Polish destroyer flotilla was moved north to Britain at the end of August.
tactics: 德軍在波蘭的基本戰術是邊界攻勢加快速縱深推進，而不是已經被神化的裝甲制勝。北方兵團群的第七軍自波美拉尼亞突破後沿南北鐵路與公路並行疾進，第一軍自東普魯士方向壓向波蘭走廊南部；南方兵團群以第八軍自波茲南側擊波軍，以第十九摩托化軍團的裝甲師作為矛尖，插入波軍縱深後合攏於維茲納、布拉尼察與索卡爾三個會合點，把波軍主力分割成數塊，再由步兵師、摩托化步兵營與工兵逐段殲滅。哈爾德與布勞姆希克出於對戰線拉長的顧慮，限制裝甲師的獨立作戰縱深，因此多數坦克仍跟在步兵師後方行進，擔任炮兵替代與破壞工事的支援角色；空軍則以俯衝轟炸機打擊縱深公路、鐵路與部隊集結地，切斷波軍補給與指揮。波軍的戰術是典型的邊境防守加縱深梯次：部隊沿國境一線展開，預計在英法在西線發動反攻時以緩慢撤退換取整頓，準備在羅馬尼亞橋頭堡長期抵抗。實戰中這套方案被德軍的推進速度與空軍破壞通信擊碎，前線各軍失去統一指揮，一個半獨立、在縱深梯次中彼此缺乏協調的集團軍被逐一突破。波軍騎兵在此環境下以兩種方式作戰：一是在維瓦維爾方向以整個騎兵旅實施衝鋒與縱深反擊，二是大量以游擊隊形式打擊德軍摩托化縱隊的側翼、割斷電話線與道路。游擊戰在波蘭南部山區與東部邊境尤為活躍，有效拖慢了德軍與蘇軍的推進節奏，也成為波蘭地下抵抗的雛形。戰役末段波軍有組織地退入羅馬尼亞橋頭堡與匈牙利邊境，最終在戰術上被壓制、在戰略上被分割包圍。
tacticsEn: The German method in Poland was a border offensive followed by rapid advance into depth, rather than the armoured triumph later mythologised. In the north the 7th Army broke out of Pomerania and drove east with the north-south railway and the roads running in parallel, while the 1st Army pressed down from East Prussia onto the southern end of the Polish Corridor; in the south the 8th Army swung behind the Polish armies from Poznan, with the panzer divisions of the XIX Motor Corps used as the spearhead, driving into depth and closing at the junctions of Wizna, Brialmont and Sokal, cutting the Polish army into several pieces which were then destroyed piece by piece by infantry divisions, motorised infantry and engineers. Halder and von Brauchitsch, worried about an over-extended front, restricted the independent operational depth of the panzer divisions, so most tanks still moved in the wake of the infantry and served as a substitute for artillery and as a means of breaking fortifications; the air force meanwhile struck roads, railways and assembly areas in depth with dive bombers in order to cut Polish supply and command. The Polish plan was a classic border defence with echeloned depth: the army deployed along the frontier, expecting to retreat slowly in order to regroup while Britain and France attacked in the west, and to hold the Romanian bridgehead for a long resistance. In practice the scheme was broken by the speed of the German advance and by the destruction of communications from the air, and the front armies lost unified command: a half-independent group of armies, poorly coordinated inside its echelons, was broken in turn. The cavalry fought in two ways in this setting, charging with whole brigades and deep counterattacks in the Wawer direction, and, far more often, operating as partisans against the flanks of the German motorised columns, cutting telephone lines and roads. Partisan activity was especially active in the southern mountains and along the eastern border, slowing the pace of the German and Soviet advance and forming the embryo of the later Polish underground state. In the closing phase the Polish army withdrew in an orderly way into the Romanian bridgehead and the Hungarian border, finally suppressed tactically and enveloped strategically.
data: 德軍陸軍總裝備量為三千四百七十二輛坦克，其中二千八百五十九輛配屬野戰部隊，四百零八輛在後備軍；七個裝甲師共有一千九百零九輛坦克，四個輕裝師另有四百五十三輛，另有二百二十五輛坦克編在獨立團與連一級單位。空軍方面，德軍共有約四千架飛機，其中可投入「白色方案」者約二千三百一十五架，包括一千一百八十架戰鬥機、二百九十架 Ju 87 俯衝轟炸機與一千一百架常規轟炸機，另有運輸機五百五十架、偵察機三百五十架。波蘭原計畫動員一百三十五萬人，因動員令被法國勸阻而延後，實際開戰時約動員九十萬人，僅及計畫的七成，戰鬥力因此打了折扣；空軍總數約六百架，可用 PZL P.11 戰鬥機約一百八十五架、PZL P.7 約九十五架、PZL.23 約一百七十五架，PZL.37 重型轟炸機實際只有三十六架可用。裝甲方面，七TP輕坦在戰前五年只生產約一百四十輛，此外有兩個裝甲旅、四個獨立坦克營與約三十個 TKS 坦克車連。波蘭陸軍總兵力約一百萬人，東部邊境防衛軍只有約二十五個營。戰役中的關鍵數字：德軍第九兵團群一部在開戰第一週推進二百二十五公里；布祖拉河戰役自九月九日至十九日，僅 Stuka 突擊航空團就投下三百八十八噸炸彈；華沙九月十三日被圍困，苦守至九月二十八日，莫德林要塞抵抗十六日後於九月二十九日投降，維斯特普拉特守軍於九月七日放棄，奧克希維耶守軍抵抗到九月十九日，赫爾半島要塞區守到十月二日，最後的科克戰役在十月六日結束。德軍損失約四萬五千人傷亡，十一千輛作戰車輛受損或被毀，其中坦克與裝甲車九百九十三輛；波蘭損失飛機三百三十三架，德國空軍損失二百八十五架、另有二百七十九架受損。
dataEn: The German army held a total of three thousand four hundred and seventy-two tanks, of which two thousand eight hundred and fifty-nine were with the field army and four hundred and eight with the replacement army; the seven panzer divisions between them had one thousand nine hundred and nine tanks, the four light divisions had a further four hundred and fifty-three, and another two hundred and twenty-five tanks sat in detached regiments and companies. The Luftwaffe had close to four thousand aircraft, of which about two thousand three hundred and fifteen were assigned to the operation: one thousand one hundred and eighty fighters, two hundred and ninety Ju 87 dive bombers and one thousand one hundred conventional bombers, with five hundred and fifty transport aircraft and three hundred and fifty reconnaissance aircraft. Poland had planned to mobilise one million three hundred and fifty thousand men, but the mobilisation order was talked down by the French and only about nine hundred thousand were actually up at the outbreak, some seventy per cent of the plan, which cut combat power accordingly; the air force had about six hundred aircraft, with roughly one hundred and eighty-five PZL P.11 fighters, ninety-five PZL P.7, one hundred and seventy-five PZL.23 and only thirty-six PZL.37 heavy bombers available. On armour, only about one hundred and forty 7TP light tanks had been built in the five years before the war, and the army also had two armoured brigades, four independent tank battalions and about thirty companies of TKS tankettes. The Polish army numbered about one million men, and the border protection corps in the east had only some twenty-five battalions. Key figures of the campaign: one corps of the German 9th army group advanced two hundred and twenty-five kilometres in the first week; the battle of the Bzura ran from 9 to 19 September, during which the Stuka dive-bomber wings alone dropped three hundred and eighty-eight tonnes of bombs; Warsaw was besieged on 13 September and held until 28 September, Modlin fortress resisted for sixteen days and surrendered on 29 September, the Westerplatte garrison gave up on 7 September, the Oksywie garrison held until 19 September, the fortified area at Hel was defended until 2 October, and the last fighting at Kock ended on 6 October. The Germans lost about forty-five thousand men and eleven thousand vehicles damaged or destroyed, of which nine hundred and ninety-three were tanks and armoured cars; Poland lost three hundred and thirty-three aircraft, while the Luftwaffe lost two hundred and eighty-five and had two hundred and seventy-nine damaged.
cause: 德國要解除《凡爾賽條約》對其邊界的束縛，取得但澤自由市與波蘭走廊，並解決德意志族少數人口的歸屬問題；波蘭不肯割地，國民議會的走廊議題成為導火線。一九三四年德波互不侵犯條約原本暫時擱置爭端，一九三九年四月二十八日希特勒單方面宣布廢約，並在五月對將領表明不會重演一九三八年的捷克斯洛伐克行動。八月間德國向波蘭提出為期十四點的方案，要求但澤與走廊歸德、並保障少數族權利，波蘭代表無權簽署，談判於八月三十一日破局；八月三十日夜德軍在格萊維茨電台製造假旗事件，作為開戰藉口。蘇聯的作用同樣關鍵：八月二十三日德蘇簽訂互不侵犯條約，秘密議定書把東歐劃分為德蘇兩個勢力範圍，波蘭幾乎被從南北兩面夾在德國與蘇聯之間，此後華沙每一次外交求援都因蘇德條約而落空。英法在三月與波蘭簽訂互助條約，卻遲遲不願因波蘭問題而承擔全面開戰的風險，其對德國的約束力在整個九月都停留在紙面上。
causeEn: Germany wanted to loosen the constraints the Treaty of Versailles had placed on its borders, to take the Free City of Danzig and the Polish Corridor, and to settle the status of the German minority. Poland would not cede territory, and the corridor question in the parliament became the flashpoint. The German-Polish Non-Aggression Pact of 1934 had shelved the dispute for a time, but on 28 April 1939 Hitler unilaterally tore it up, and in May he told his generals that the action in Poland would not be a repeat of 1938 in Czechoslovakia. In August Germany put a fourteen-point proposal to Warsaw, asking for Danzig and the corridor and for guaranteed minority rights, and the Polish delegate had no powers to sign, so the talks collapsed on 31 August; on the night of 31 August German troops staged the Gleiwitz radio incident as the pretext for war. The Soviet role was equally decisive: the German-Soviet Non-Aggression Pact of 23 August divided eastern Europe into German and Soviet spheres of influence, and Poland was caught between Germany and the Soviet Union from north to south, so that every Polish appeal to the wider world failed in the shadow of that pact. Britain and France had signed a mutual assistance treaty with Poland in March, yet they were unwilling to take the risk of a general war over Poland, and their obligation to Warsaw remained on paper throughout September.
impact: 波蘭戰役是第二次世界大戰的開端，也是波蘭第二次亡國。波蘭國家機關在九月崩潰，政府流亡國外，波蘭地下國在佔領區成立，被俘的波軍士兵有一部分在西方組成波蘭軍隊，法國波蘭軍、自由法國波蘭第二軍與蘇聯波軍陸續成軍，這支部隊最終參與了諾曼第登陸與歐陸戰事。疆土上，德國取得但澤與波蘭走廊，把西部國土直接併入第三帝國，東南部設總督區並劃為四個軍事區；蘇聯則依秘密議定書吞併東波蘭，取得比薩拉比亞，並在諾門罕停火翌日即行出兵，使東線在德軍背後出現，使波蘭全境在三十六天內落入兩國之手。軍事思想上，這場戰役確立了空軍制空、裝甲快速縱深與鐵路調度合一的快速戰爭樣板，後來被稱為「閃擊戰」；但德軍參謀總長哈爾德與總司令布勞姆希克限制裝甲作戰縱深、戰術仍以步兵為核心的實際情況，也說明這種樣板並非憑空而來，其極限在一年後的法國戰役中暴露無遺。政治上，綏靖政策的破產使西方體認到德國擴張不會止步，兩年的喘息換來的是更強的對手與一場更大的戰爭；德國在波蘭測試出的後勤與工業動員能力，則成為其兩年後進攻蘇聯的底氣。
impactEn: The Polish Campaign was the opening of the Second World War and the second partition of Poland. The Polish state collapsed within September: the government went into exile, the underground state was formed in the occupied territories, and some of the men taken prisoner re-formed into Polish forces in the West, with the Polish Army in France, the Polish 2nd Corps in the Free French forces and the Polish forces in the Soviet Union, which eventually took part in the Normandy landings and in the campaigns in western Europe. In the east, Germany took Danzig and the Polish Corridor and folded the western territories directly into the Reich, while the central and southern regions became the General Government divided into four military districts; the Soviet Union took eastern Poland under the secret protocol, obtained Bessarabia, and marched in on the very day after the ceasefire in the Far East, so that a second front appeared behind the German army and the whole of Poland fell to the two powers within thirty-six days. In military thinking the campaign set the pattern of air supremacy, fast armoured advance and rail mobilisation, later called Blitzkrieg; yet the fact that Halder and von Brauchitsch restricted the operational depth of the armoured forces and that the tactics remained centred on the infantry shows that the pattern was not conjured from nothing, and its limits were laid bare a year later in the campaign in France. Politically the collapse of appeasement taught the West that German expansion would not stop, and two years of breathing space bought a stronger opponent and a larger war; the logistics and industrial mobilisation tested by Poland in 1939 gave Germany the confidence it needed for its attack on the Soviet Union two years later.
result: 九月一日開戰至九月底，波蘭軍隊在西部與中部被逐出國土，國防軍主力在西線被分割、在東線被蘇軍切斷，最後在羅馬尼亞邊境與南部山地零星抵抗。九月十六日里茲-希米格爾被解除最高統帥職，由西科爾斯基接任總參謀長並組閣流亡政府，波蘭從未正式投降，而是以撤退與分散作戰換取有生力量。九月十七日蘇軍越境，二十二日占領利沃夫，二十八日德軍進入華沙，莫德林要塞在抵抗十六日後於二十九日投降，十月六日科克方向的戰鬥結束，德軍與蘇軍取得對波蘭全境的控制。九月二十八日德蘇在莫斯科議定分界，線路推至布格河一帶；十月八日德國正式把西部國土與但澤併入版圖，剩餘中部與南部設波蘭總督區，十一月間國會遷往華沙，國家行政機構在中樞淪陷後分散遷到各地。從純軍事角度看，德軍以三十六天攻下一個有百萬軍力、數百輛坦克與六百架飛機的國家，速度之快前所未有；從戰略角度波蘭失敗得更徹底，計畫中的縱深梯次與反包圍從未成形，西部兩個集團軍的通信在開戰首週即被空軍與德軍游擊破壞，蘇軍的如期越境則抽走了波蘭政府最後一項戰略假設。
resultEn: From 1 September to the end of that month the Polish armies were driven out of the west and the centre of the country, the bulk of the national army cut off in the west and cut in two from the east by the Soviet advance, with only scattered resistance left in the Romanian borderland and the southern mountains. On 16 September Rydz-Smigly was relieved as supreme commander, Wladyslaw Sikorski took over as chief of the general staff and formed the exile government, and Poland never formally surrendered, trading retreat and dispersed resistance for the survival of its forces in being. The Soviet army crossed the border on 17 September, took Lwow on the 22nd, German troops entered Warsaw on the 28th, Modlin capitulated on the 29th after sixteen days of fighting, and the last battle at Kock ended on 6 October, giving Germany and the Soviet Union control of all Poland. On 28 September the two powers fixed their line in Moscow, pushing it eastward to the Bug, and on 8 October Germany formally annexed the western territories and Danzig, setting up the General Government over the rest, with the seat of government moved to Warsaw in November and the central administration dispersed to the districts after the fall of the capital. In purely military terms the Germans took a country of one million men, several hundred tanks and six hundred aircraft in thirty-six days, a speed without precedent; in strategic terms the Polish defeat was more complete still, because the planned echeloned depth and the counter-envelopment never took shape, the communications of the two western army groups were broken by air attack and partisan action in the first week, and the timely Soviet crossing removed the last strategic assumption on which the Polish plan rested.
